jobs.description: About Allianz Global InvestorsAllianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. To Recruitment Agencies:Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Let's care for tomorrow.How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. The team retains end-to-end responsibility for portfolio strategy, pacing, investment decisions and ongoing portfolio steering. The team is part of risklab, the solutions pillar of Allianz Global Investors' global investment platform, and works closely with other risklab teams, on modelling of private markets, strategic asset allocation advice, and holistic public-private portfolios.The Portfolio Analyst supports the construction and ongoing management of diversified private markets mandates and evergreen funds through portfolio analysis, investment monitoring, pacing and liquidity modelling, and preparation of investment decisions. Working across asset classes and alongside experienced portfolio managers, the role offers broad exposure to the full portfolio lifecycle and a clear path toward increasing investment responsibility.What you will do- Produce portfolio, exposure, diversification, performance and scenario analyses- Maintain pacing, commitment, cash-flow and liquidity models- Monitor portfolios against investment guidelines, allocation targets and risk limits- Analyse investment opportunities and prepare materials for portfolio reviews and investment committees- Coordinate portfolio data and inputs from specialist investment teams, operations and reporting functions- Improve analytical tools, dashboards and investment processes, while gradually taking ownership of defined workstreamsWhat you bring- Master's degree or equivalent qualification in finance, economics, business administration or another quantitative discipline; initial knowledge of private markets strongly preferred.- Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including financial modelling, cash-flow analysis and interpretation of portfolio data.- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with data-analysis or visualisation tools is an advantage.- Ability to translate complex analysis into clear, decision-relevant conclusions and materials.- Structured and reliable, with strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.- Flexible and self-reliant, with the ability to take ownership, adapt to changing priorities and proactively drive assigned work forward.- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across investment teams, asset classes and functions.- Fluent verbal and written skills in both English and German required.- Experience with Data Analytics, Data Modelling and Microsoft CoPilot.What we offer- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)- Company share purchasing plan- Mental health and wellbeing programs- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group- Self-guided learning & development- … and so much more!

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join a dynamic engineering product development team focused on industrial gas turbines for power generation! Each day, you will engage in both independent and collaborative work, tackling various engine component design projects, improvements, and technical challenges. Your role will involve close collaboration with colleagues and global resources, ensuring that innovative ideas and solutions are shared. You will have the opportunity to continuously learn through hands-on tasks, application of your discipline knowledge, and participation in both technical and non-technical courses. By utilizing cutting-edge design and analysis tools, you will identify areas for improvement and communicate your findings directly with internal customers, stakeholders, and leadership teams.How You’ll Make an Impact * Contribution to turbine hot gas path component design through thermal analyses and development of high-performance solutions for efficiency, component lifetime, robustness, and manufacturability* Support of engine and component testing through definition of validation requirements, preparation of test predictions, and execution of post-test data reduction and analysis* Advancement of Conjugate Heat Transfer (CHT) 3D thermal design methodologies through application to new engine components and upgrades, including identification of innovative implementation approaches* Continuous improvement of thermal analysis tools, tool chains, and automated workflows, including evaluation and integration of AI/ML-based capabilities for enhanced functionality and analysis fidelityWhat You Bring* University degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering with specialization in thermo-fluid sciences* Industrial experience in turbomachinery, turbine hot gas path thermal design, fluid systems, and related applications* Strong expertise in heat transfer principles as well as FEA, CFD, CAD, and Conjugate Heat Transfer (CHT) methodologies* Experience in thermal testing and validation, including test planning, instrumentation, data analysis, and interpretation* Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, global Integrated Product Team environments with strong communication and collaboration skills* Highly motivated, proactive, self-directed, and innovative mindset with business-fluent English skills; basic German language skills are requiredAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators.
